conventions.ingredient_count_band: Counted ingredients exclude salt, black pepper, water, and cooking oils: <=12 -> 0, 13-16 -> 1, 17+ -> 2.
conventions.pantry_familiarity: Kept 0; specialty-store items score once under specialty_burden (no double counting). Cultural unfamiliarity adds no points.

reason_codes_status: proposed (closed reason-code list not on box at authoring)
rationale: Roasting and the soup simmer are hands-off, but griddling 4 sandwiches in 2 batches needs flipping and watching (attention 1). Soup plus sandwiches scores components 1. Oven, pot, immersion blender, and skillet run in parallel (coordination 1). Score 4 is moderate; WAVE proposed easy. Every ingredient is mainstream (vegetarian-rennet cheddar is labeled and widely stocked), so complexity is simple.
